download_mtedx_data: download mTEDx dataset from OpenSLR for a given source and target language pair
download_mtedx_lang_videos: download TED talk videos from YouTube for a specific language across train, valid, and test splits
preprocess_mtedx_audio: segment and normalize mTEDx audio files to 16kHz mono WAV format for a given language
preprocess_mtedx_video: segment and normalize mTEDx video files into cropped mouth ROI clips at 25 FPS for a given language
prepare_mtedx_avsr_manifests: create audio-visual speech recognition manifest TSV files mapping segmented audio and video paths for a language
